notes:
Insert signed NCD and Register a new battery work right after Read SVT: they asked to read the SVT again, and again. Safer with two cars in a row: an SVT read from car A no longer counts for car B after you connect car B; read the SVT of car B first.
Also in 4.6.0: green when it worked, red when it failed, for every write and coding result. After writing the vehicle order in Type and codes, Code them for me codes the modules (it saves each module's coding first and checks it after). The car report keeps the faults the car came in with, also after you clear them. The Backup button opens the full backup in one click. Edit settings opens the FDL-Editor faster. About 2,000 more cheat sheet tweaks.
